title: Add VPC control plane Terraform: multi-AZ subnets, endpoints, SGs, peering, Route53 DNS
author: Samara Nguyen
release_notes: Adds Terraform modules and example stacks to provision control plane VPC resources required for Private deployments, including multi-AZ subnets, interface and gateway endpoints, security group templates, VPC peering, and Route53 zone peering and DNS delegation. Includes backwards-compatible variables and migration guide. No breaking changes.
commits: init: add modules/network skeleton and README
feat: implement multi-az subnet module with az-aware CIDR allocation
feat: add endpoints module for interface and gateway endpoints with policy attachment
chore: add security group templates and reusable rules for control plane
feat: add route53 zone peering and delegated DNS module + examples
docs: add migration guide and integration test scaffolding
description: Motivation: private deployments require a repeatable, auditable Terraform stack to provision the control-plane network resources (multi-AZ subnets, interface and gateway endpoints, security groups, VPC peering, and Route53 DNS/zone peering) used by the Private installer and on-prem distributions. This PR adds a set of composable Terraform modules and an opinionated example stack to bootstrap a control-plane VPC that matches Redwood Private requirements. Summary of changes: adds modules/network (vpc, subnets, endpoints, sgs, route53-peering), an examples/private/control-plane stack, CI validation workflow updates, an upgrade/migration guide for existing customers, and integration tests. Checklist: [x] Terraform modules with input/output docs, [x] example stack for single-account multi-AZ deployment, [x] integration test scaffold + basic provisioning test, [x] docs and migration guide added, [x] helm values comment referencing network config. Testing and validation: ran terraform init/validate/plan against example using AWS test account, ran integration provisioning test in CI (provision/destroy), validated Route53 zone peering DNS resolution in staging, and exercised endpoints policies against control-plane tasks. Backwards compatibility: variables are additive and default to previous behavior where applicable. Upgrade notes: see scripts/upgrade/terraform-migration.md for a small state move when customers adopt route53 peering; migration steps are documented and automated where possible. Risks and mitigations: careful with CIDR allocation - module supports explicit CIDR or AZ-based offsets and includes safeguards to avoid overlap. No breaking API changes to the installer. Follow-ups: wire the modules into the installer orchestration and add RBAC-aware SG templates in a follow-up.
review_comments: Aisha Patel (review): overall looks good, please add more unit tests around the CIDR allocation edge cases and document the expected AZ ordering for customers using custom AZ names.

Miguel Torres (review): the endpoint policy for S3 gateway access needs explicit condition to restrict to control-plane role; otherwise LGTM.
Author (Samara): tightened the endpoint policy condition and added a test case verifying IAM principal restriction.
Ben Carlson (approval): Verified integration test run in staging; terraform plan looks clean. Approving to squash-merge once CI is green.
